# RichText

```csharp
public sealed class RichText
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

A cell's text in stretches of different fonts, as Excel keeps text formatted character by character: a word in bold, a unit in superscript. The cell's value is the whole text; runs without text of their own are dropped. A record: rich texts compare by value, run by run.
